summary.en: Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan warned Beijing could easily win a conflict with the Philippines, prompting PCG Rear Admiral Jay Tarriela to label the remark a direct threat. The Philippines and the United States conducted their 16th bilateral maritime exercise in the West Philippine Sea, while the Philippines and Japan held an anti-piracy drill in Manila Bay and Japan began modernization support for the Philippine Coast Guard. The PCG opened an upgraded station on Pag-asa Island and monitored several Chinese naval assets near Scarborough Shoal. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesisk ambassadør Jing Quan advarte at Beijing lett kunne vinne en konflikt med Filippinene, noe som fikk PCG-rear Admiral Jay Tarriela til å betegne bemerkningen som en direkte trussel. Filippinene og USA gjennomførte sin 16. bilaterale maritime øvelse i Vestfilippinske hav, mens Filippinene og Japan holdt en anti-piratøvelse i Manila Bay og Japan startet moderniseringsstøtte til Filippinenes kystvakt. PCG åpnet en oppgradert stasjon på Pag-asa-øya og overvåket flere kinesiske marineenheter nær Scarborough-skorpen. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
